name: SP4 画像与弓·克与宸（人物传VOL.3）
desc: 2026 暑假特辑·人物传 VOL.3 高级档（双传主：克与宸） · 15 道自包含单选（while 对比/one…the other/Neither of/prefer to/so that/主将从现/both/opposite/must be 推测/never+完成/过去被动/All three/whether+不定式/seem to/图证反选）。双传记阅读与姐弟互批在纸卷上。

m5.q: 6. ___ the sister loved quiet, the brother loved noise.
7. They had two treasures: ___ was a covered portrait, and ___ was a wall of bows.
m5.why: 正确：两者固定搭配 one…the other。

m5.q: 8. ___ of the two ever crossed the line.
m5.why: 正确：两者都不 + 单数谓语。

m5.q: 10. She covered the portrait ___ nobody could see it.
11. If she ever ___ back, the room will be exactly as she left it.
12. Both halves of the room ___ a carpet of their own.
13. The bow wall is ___ the covered portrait.
14. Look at the stripes — the big shadow in the window ___ a tiger.
m5.why: 正确：证据确凿 → must be。

m5.q: 15. He has ___ shot a single arrow — look at the clean target.
16. The room ___ into two halves by a line of tape years ago.
17. ___ three shadows passed the window at dusk.
18. She stood at the gate, not knowing ___ to look back or not.
m5.why: 正确：whether to do or not。

m5.q: 19. The two treasures ___ to share one secret: both are kept, and never used.
m5.why: 正确：复数 → seem to share。

m5.q: 20. 对照旧屋再读四句——只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: There are eight bows on the wall.
The tape line is still on the floor.
Both of the treasures belongs to the sister.
The empty chair is on the sister's side.
m5.why: 正确（此句有错）：both → belong；且弓墙不属于姐姐。
